meta.title: Elisa-Didun, tagellidt tasersayt n Qarṭaǧ
meta.desc: Tagellidt n Ṣur, trewl, tasersayt n Qarṭaǧ ɣer 814 send Ɛisa : tudert n Elisa-Didun akken i d-qqaren Timée d Justin, akked wamek i tt-id-yesnulfa Virgile.
hero.dates: Lqern wis 9 send Ɛisa · asers ɣer 814
hero.title: Elisa-Didun
hero.lede: Tagellidt n Ṣur, trewl tesers : tagellidt tafiniqit i yesnulfan seg unebɣi n texriǧ talalit n temdint — Qart-Ḥadašt, « Tamdint tamaynut ».
hero.alt: Enya iḥekku i Didun lmihanat n Tṛuya, sɣur Pierre-Narcisse Guérin
hero.caption: P.-N. Guérin, Enya iḥekku i Didun lmihanat n Tṛuya (1815)
keys.0.t: send Ɛisa : azemz n users yeqbel sɣur Timée
keys.1.t: tullas n Chypre ṣuffɣent ɣer Afrika (Justin)
keys.2.t: aglim n uzger i uẓi n tɣilt n Byrsa
keys.3.t: iseggasen n Qarṭaǧ tapunit, armi d 146 send Ɛisa
names.items.0.name: Elisa
names.items.0.text: D isem i s-fkan Timée d Justin, ammas d asuɣel n yisem afiniqi. Tunsiyen semman-as ass-a Elisa (عليسة).
names.items.1.name: Didun
names.items.1.text: Akken i d-yeqqar Timée, Ilibikiyen semman-as Deidô, « tirurit », ɣef ddeɛwa n tikliwin-is iɣezfen. D isem-agi i yeqbel Virgile.
life.title: Tudert, seg Ṣur armi d Byrsa
life.rows.0.title: Tagellidt tameẕyant
life.rows.0.text: Yelli-s n ugellid Mutto (Bélus ɣer Virgile), weltma-s n Pygmalion. Agellid yeǧǧa akersi i sin warraw-is ; agdud yefka-t i Pygmalion, mazal-it d aqcic.
life.rows.1.title: Acherbas
life.rows.1.text: Elisa tezweǧ xali-s Acherbas (Sychée ɣer Virgile), ameqqran n ikahinen n Melqart — Hercule n Ṣur —, d wis sin deg tgelda mbeɛd agellid.
life.rows.2.title: Pygmalion
life.rows.2.text: Yettraǧu ayla n Acherbas, Pygmalion yesnɣa-t.
life.rows.3.title: Tiḥerci n lmal
life.rows.3.text: Elisa tesken-d belli teqbel, tsers ddheb ɣef lbabura akked imeqqranen n Ṣur, tegr ɣer lebḥer icwalen n ṣṣabla i d-qqaren d lmal : ibaɛɛaten n ugellid, uggaden, ḍefṛen-tt.
life.rows.4.title: Aslaka
life.rows.4.text: Akahin n tegzirt yedda yid-s akked twacult-is, mgal lɛahed n lkahna yettwalin ɣer tarwa ; 80 n tullas ṣuffɣent-d d tilawin i yimezdaɣen imaynuten.
life.rows.5.title: Tiwweḍ ɣer Afrika
life.rows.5.text: Tesɣa azal n tmurt i tezmer aglim n uzger ad t-iɣumm. Utique, tamdint n Ṣur taqdimt ugar, tazen-d tikfawin ; imezdaɣ i s-iqeṛben usan-d ad znuzun.
life.rows.6.title: Snat lɛalamat
life.rows.6.text: Mi ɣzan lateg, ufan-d aqerru n uzger — tamurt yesɛan afellaḥ maca d laɛbudiyya — imbeɛd, ɣer tama, aqerru n uyis : lɛalama n wegdud n umenɣi yesɛan tazmert.
life.rows.7.title: Ahaddad
life.rows.7.text: Agellid n Maxitani yessuter ad yezweǧ Elisa, s uhaddad n umenɣi ; imeqqranen iqarṭaǧiyen ḥeṛṣen-tt ad teqbel.
life.rows.8.title: Times
life.rows.8.text: Tesbedd times, tesken-d d akken d asfel i ruḥ n argaz-is, tali fell-as tewwet iman-is s ujenwi. Qarṭaǧ tqadar-itt am tyillut.
byrsa.title: Aglim n uzger
byrsa.paras.0: Mi tewweḍ ɣer rrif n lebḥer n Tunisia n wussan-a, Elisa tessuter i yimezdaɣ azal n tmurt i tezmer aglim n uzger ad t-iɣumm. Tgezzem-it d izirigen rqiqen armi tezzi s wannect-nni akk tiɣilt : Byrsa.
byrsa.paras.1: Igrikiyen fehhmen akka isem n lqelɛa (bursa, « aglim »), i d-yekkan ammas seg wawal asamit yebɣan ad yini lqelɛa. Tamacahut-agi d-tenna ayen ixataren : tamusni d tsertit nnyafen ɣef tezmert.
byrsa.quote: Azal n tmurt i tezmer aglim n uzger ad t-iɣumm.
byrsa.caption: Tiɣilt n Byrsa, ul n Qarṭaǧ
myth.title: Snat tqissiyin, snat n tgelliden
myth.aside: Taqsist tafiniqit i d-yettwaselken sɣur Igrikiyen, akked wamek i tt-id-yura daɣen Iṛumaniyen.
myth.items.0.kicker: Virgile, Énéide I d IV (19 send Ɛisa)
myth.items.0.title: Tamezwarut yettwaǧǧan
myth.items.0.paras.0: Virgile yeg Didun d tamezwarut n Enya, i tt-yeǧǧan s lameṛ n iyilluten iwakken ad yeddu ad yesres Ṛuma ; tenɣa iman-is s lexsas tdeɛɛu ɣef dderya-s tnadi aṭṭaf n lḥif — Hanibal.
myth.items.0.paras.1: Tamacahut tasersayt taṛumanit, i d-yefhamen lkeṛh ger Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ, maca tjerreḥ tagellidt ɣer tmeṭṭut kan yeẓẓuɣuṛen.
myth.items.1.title: Tagellidt tḥekmen
myth.items.1.paras.0: Deg ddɛawa taqdimt ugar, Enya ur d-iḍhir ara. Elisa d tasersayt n lḥekma i yemmuten iwakken ad teqqim d tin yeḥmel Acherbas tḥader tilelli n temdint-is zdat Iarbas.
myth.items.1.paras.1: Akked abdar n wussan ur yezmir ara ad yili : aɣelli n Tṛuya, yettwajerben akken i t-id-nɣilen ɣer 1184 send Ɛisa, yezwar ugar n krad iqrunen asers n Qarṭaǧ.
death.title: Temmut i temdint-is
death.paras.0: Tḥercen-tt Iarbas akked yimeqqranen-is, Elisa tesken-d belli teqbel azweǧ. Tesbedd times ɣer tewwura n temdint, am akken ad sserseḍ ṛuḥ n wergaz-is amenzu, imbeɛd tenɣa iman-is zdat ugdud-is : tedda, tenna, ɣer wergaz-is, akken i as-ssuturen.
death.paras.1: Akken i d-yeqqar Justin, tettwaqadar am tyillut skud Qarṭaǧ ur tettwanyif ara.
death.alt: Azru apuni s ucaraf n Tanit
death.caption: Azru s ucaraf n Tanit
quotes.title: Ayen d-qqaren Imezwura
quotes.items.0.tr: Skud Qarṭaǧ ur tettwanyif ara, tettwaqadar am tyillut.
quotes.items.0.cite: Justin, Agzul n Imezruyen Ifilibiyen, XVIII, 6
quotes.items.1.tr: Ekker-ed seg yiɣsan-nneɣ, a aṭṭaf n lḥif, anwa i telliḍ.
quotes.items.1.cite: Virgile, Énéide, IV, 625 — Didun tenɛal Hanibal
sourcesNote.title: Seg wanda i d-yekka wayen i nessen
sourcesNote.items.0.text: Amesnezruy agrikan (lqern wis 4–3 send Ɛisa) : talɣa taqdimt akteṛ yettwassnen, yeqqar-d asers n 814 yettbeggen-d isem n Didun.
sourcesNote.items.1.text: Yettwabedren sɣur Flavius Josèphe (Contre Apion, I, 18) : arewl n Elisa akked users dehrent deg useggas wis sebɛa n tgelda n Pygmalion.
sourcesNote.items.2.text: Agzul n Imezruyen Ifilibiyen n Trogue Pompée, adlis XVIII : aɣbalu agejdan n teqsist (arewl, Chypre, aglim n uzger, Iarbas, times).
sourcesNote.items.3.text: Énéide, idlisen I d IV : talɣa taṛumanit s ungal, ad tettwaɣer d adlis n ccɛeṛ d tsertit, mačči d amezruy.
sourcesNote.items.4.text: Libyca (lqern wis 2 mbeɛd Ɛisa) : tamuɣli tagrikit ɣef lɛerq n Qarṭaǧ d tḥerci n uglim n uzger.
legacy.title: Lmirat n tasersayt
legacy.alt: Didun tebna Qarṭaǧ, sɣur J. M. W. Turner
legacy.caption: J. M. W. Turner, Didun tebna Qarṭaǧ (1815)
legacy.items.0.title: Tamdint n sebɛa iqrunen
legacy.items.0.text: Qarṭaǧ, seg 814 armi d 146 send Ɛisa, tuɣal d tazmert tameqqrant n lebḥer di Lebḥer Ageraɣlan Lɣarbi, tamesmixert n Ṛuma ugar n lqern.
legacy.items.1.title: Iẓuran n Ṣur
legacy.items.1.text: Tunigin n lebḥer, ttjara, asekkil, tanezlit n Melqart : lmirat n Ṣur yesnulfa idles aqarṭaǧi seg lqaɛa-ines.
legacy.items.2.title: Tagellidt deg tsenɛatin
legacy.items.2.text: Ovide (Héroïdes, VII), Purcell (Dido and Aeneas, 1689), Berlioz (Les Troyens), Guérin akked Turner (1815) : Didun tezger tasekla, lopera d uẓwaɣ.
legacy.items.3.title: Acaraf atunsi
legacy.items.3.text: Elisa tqqim-d ass-a, di Tunisia, d tugna tasersayt s telqey, d acaraf n tmusni tasertant d tnezmert.
more.title: Ɣer daɣen
more.items.0.title: Asers n Qarṭaǧ
more.items.0.text: Qart-Ḥadašt, Tamdint tamaynut, akked iqrunen-is imezwura.
more.items.1.title: Ddin
more.items.1.text: Melqart, Baal Hammon, Tanit : iyilluten n Qarṭaǧ.
more.items.2.title: Akk imezruyen n tudert
more.items.2.text: At Barka, imenzaway n umenɣi, imsegmaḏ n lebḥer akked tgelliden.
